blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The Unitree Go1 is a widely used platform for legged robotics research, yet collecting proprioceptive data from it is unnecessarily difficult: the Unitree SDK is sparsely documented, and ROS1 (Robot Operating System), the Go1's native middleware, is fully deprecated. We present an open-source graphical utility that enables researchers to reliably record proprioceptive data from the Go1, including joint states, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) readings, foot force sensor data, and gyroscope measurements, without requiring ROS expertise. The tool provides a simple GUI (Graphical User Interface) for starting, stopping, and labeling recordings in real time. The contribution of this paper is the collection utility. We characterize the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with it, including the achieved sampling rate and repeated samples. As a secondary, deliberately modest check that the data is useful, we train a terrain classifier on it. The results are weak: a Temporal Convolutional Network reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes (10% would be chance), and a window-level split that ignores recording boundaries inflates the same measurement to about 99%. We report this as a demonstration that the logged signals carry terrain information, not as a competitive classifier. The utility is designed to lower the barrier to collecting Go1 proprioceptive data without ROS.
blocks.zh: Unitree Go1是一个广泛使用的用于腿形机器人研究的平台,然而从它收集自制数据却不必要地困难:Unitree SDK的文献资料很少,Go1的原生中件ROS1(Robot操作系统)则被完全贬值. 我们提供了一个开源图形工具,使研究人员能够可靠地记录Go1的自发数据,包括联合状态、IMU(惯性测量单位)读数、脚力传感器数据和陀螺仪测量,而不需要ROS的专门知识。 该工具提供了一个简单的图形用户界面(GUI)(Graphical User Interface),用于实时开始,停止和标签录音. 本文件的贡献是收集工具。 我们描述与它一起收集的51份录音的获取质量,包括达到的取样率和重复样品。 作为二级的,刻意的微调数据有用, 我们训练一个地形分类器在上面。 其结果是微弱的:一个Temperal Curvolutional Network在10个地形等级的被搁置录音上达到约38%的准确度(10%是偶然的),而一个窗口层的分割忽略了记录边界,将同样的测量夸大到约99%. 我们报告这是为了证明记录的信号携带地形信息,而不是作为一个竞争性的分类器. 该用途旨在降低障碍,以收集没有ROS的Go1自主数据。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
The Unitree Go1 [ 1 ] is a widely deployed quadrupedal
robot platform used by academic laboratories and hobbyists for legged
locomotion research. The Go1 remains attractive due to its low cost,
variety of sensors, ample onboard compute, and open-source nature. Continued research interest in the platform is evidenced by recent work on benchmarking locomotion controllers [ 2 ] , state estimation [ 3 ] , and novel sensing modalities [ 4 ] .

Unitree Go1 [1] 是部署广泛的四重奏
学术实验室和爱好者用于腿部的机器人平台
运动研究. GO1型因其成本低而仍然具有吸引力,
各种各样的传感器, 大量的机载计算, 和开源性质。 对该平台的持续研究兴趣表现在最近关于确定运动控制器的基准[2]、状态估计[3]和新型感知方式[4]的工作上。

blocks.en:
Working with the Go1 in practice, however, presents significant
challenges. The official Unitree SDK is insufficiently
documented [ 5 ] , and the Go1’s native middleware
is ROS1, which has reached end-of-life [ 6 ] . Unitree’s ROS1
package recommends Ubuntu 18.04 and ROS Melodic, both of which are
past end-of-life. The combination of an insufficiently documented SDK, unsupported software, and a deprecated middleware creates a steep barrier to entry for researchers who simply wish to collect data from the robot.

blocks.en:
Prior work has demonstrated the value of proprioceptive sensing for legged robot tasks including terrain classification [ 7 , 8 ] and obstacle estimation [ 9 ] ,
but to the best of our knowledge no generalized, easy-to-use
proprioceptive data collection framework has been released for this platform.
blocks.zh:
以前的工作表明,自发感应对有腿机器人任务的价值,包括地形分类[7、8]和障碍估计[9],
但据我们所知 没有普遍、容易使用
本平台已发布了自主数据收集框架。

blocks.en: This paper presents an open-source, GUI-based utility that allows any researcher to collect labeled proprioceptive data from the Unitree Go1 without requiring ROS knowledge or deep familiarity with the Unitree SDK. The tool records joint states, IMU data, gyroscope data, and foot force sensor data, exporting structured CSV files suitable for direct use in machine learning pipelines. The focus of this paper is the utility, not the classifier. To show that the logged data is useful, we collect a multi-terrain dataset and train a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) [ 10 ] for terrain classification. This is a demonstration only, and its results are weak. We report accuracy on held-out recordings (about 38% over ten classes, against 10% chance) next to the much higher window-level accuracy (about 99%) that results when recording boundaries are ignored, and we characterize the acquisition quality of the logs, including the achieved sampling rate. The utility is released under the MIT License at https://github.com/RoLACLab/go1-proprioceptive-logger .
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了一个基于GUI的开源工具,允许任何研究人员从Unitree Go1中收集被标注的自发数据,而不需要ROS知识或对Unitree SDK的深度熟悉. 该工具记录了联合状态,IMU数据,陀螺仪数据和脚力传感器数据,输出结构化的CSV文件,适合直接用于机器学习管. 本文的焦点是效用,而不是分类器. 为了证明所记录的数据是有用的,我们收集了多地铁数据集,并训练了TTCN [10] 为地形分类. 这仅仅是一次示范,其成果也微弱. 我们报告被搁置的录音的准确性(大约38 % 超过10类,而概率为10%),紧接在记录边界时结果被忽略的更高的窗口级别准确性(大约99%)之后,我们描述记录的获取质量,包括已经实现的采样率。 该工具根据麻省理工学院许可证发布,网址为https://github.com/RoLACLab/go1-prioceptive-logger 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: II Background
blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况

blocks.en: II-A The Unitree Go1 Platform
blocks.zh: II-A 团结GO1平台

blocks.en: The Unitree Go1 [ 1 ] is a quadrupedal robot weighing 12 kg with a payload capacity of roughly 3 to 5 kg. It has 12 degrees of freedom (three per leg: body, thigh, and shank joints) driven by precision motors producing up to 35.55 N ⋅ \cdot m peak torque at the knee. The EDU version used in this work is equipped with foot-end force sensors on each leg, onboard IMUs, and onboard Jetson compute modules, providing 16 CPU cores and a 384-core GPU capable of 1.5 TFLOPS. The robot reaches a maximum speed of 3.7 m/s and exposes all sensor data through the Unitree Legged SDK via a high-level API over wired Ethernet or Wi-Fi.
blocks.zh: Unitree Go1 [1]是一款重达12公斤的四重机器人,有效载荷容量约为3至5公斤. 它有12个自由度(每条腿有3个:身体,大腿和腿关节),由精密马达可出产到35.55个. 膝盖有顶峰扭矩 本作中使用的EDU版本为每条腿上,机载IMU上,以及机载Jetson计算模块上都配备了脚端力感应器,提供16个CPU核心和一个能提供1.5个TFLOPS的384个核心GPU. 机器人达到最高速度为3.7 m/s,并通过Unitree Leged SDK通过有线以太网或Wi-Fi上的高级API来曝光所有传感器数据.

blocks.en: II-B Proprioceptive Sensing in Legged Robots
blocks.zh: II-B 腿部机器人的主动感测

blocks.en:
Proprioceptive sensing, encompassing joint state, inertial, and contact force information, has proven essential for a range of legged robot tasks [ 11 , 12 ] . Applications include terrain classification [ 7 , 8 ] ,
obstacle estimation [ 9 ] , ground reaction force estimation [ 3 ] . These sensing modalities enable robust locomotion in addition to exteroceptive sensors, which can improve the reliability in adverse conditions such as snow, ice, rain, or low-light environments.
blocks.zh:
主动感应,包括联合状态、惯性以及接触力信息,已证明对一系列有腿机器人任务[11、12]至关重要。 应用包括地形分类[7,8],
障碍估计[9],地面反应力估计[3]. 这些感应方式除了能产生振荡感应器之外,还能够产生强力运动,这可以提高在雪、冰、雨或低光环境等不利条件下的可靠性。

blocks.en: II-C Existing Data Collection Approaches
blocks.zh: II-C 现有数据收集方法

blocks.en: Existing approaches to proprioceptive data collection on legged robots typically rely on custom ROS-based logging scripts or vendor-specific tooling. For the Go1 specifically, deprecated ROS1 ecosystem and sparse SDK documentation have made consistent data collection difficult [ 5 ] . In addition, certain sensors, like the foot pressure sensors, are not exposed through ROS1. To the best of our knowledge, no open, GUI-accessible proprioceptive data collection utility has previously been published for this platform.
blocks.zh: 腿部机器人自主数据收集的现有方法通常依赖于基于自定义ROS的伐木脚本或供应商专用工具. 对GO1来说,具体来说,堕落的ROS1生态系统和稀疏的SDK文件使得连贯的数据收集困难 [5]. 此外,某些传感器,如脚压传感器,没有通过ROS1暴露出. 就我们所知,本平台以前没有出版开放的、可访问的GUI自主数据收集工具。

blocks.en: III System Design
blocks.zh: 三. 系统设计

blocks.en: III-A Architecture Overview
blocks.zh: 三-A 结构概况

blocks.en: The utility runs on a laptop connected to the Go1 via Ethernet (preferred) or Wi-Fi. The system consists of two layers: a C++ backend that interfaces directly with the Unitree Legged SDK to poll sensor data, and a Python graphical user interface that wraps the compiled C++ executable and provides researcher-facing controls. This architecture avoids any dependency on ROS, allowing the tool to run on modern Ubuntu distributions under Python 3. Fig. 1 illustrates the overall system design.
blocks.zh: 该工具运行在通过以太网(首选)或Wi-Fi连接到Go1的笔记本电脑上. 系统由两层组成:一是直接与Unitree Leged SDK接口的C++后端,以对传感器数据进行投票;一是Python图形用户界面,将所编译的C++可执行文件包起来,并提供研究人员-造型控制. 这个架构避免了对ROS的任何依赖,使得工具可以在Python 3下运行现代的Ubuntu分布. 图1说明了总体系统设计。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: System architecture. A C++ backend communicates with the Unitree SDK over Ethernet or Wi-Fi via UDP at about 50 Hz. A Python GUI spawns the backend as a subprocess, reads its stdout stream for live sensor data, and writes labeled CSV recordings.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:系统架构. 一个C++后端与Unitree SDK通过以太网或Wi-Fi在约50Hz时通过UDP进行通信. A Python GUI将后端作为子进程产出,为活感光数据读取其stdout流,并写入被标注为CSV录音.

blocks.en: Robot state arrives at about 50 Hz in our setup (Section IV-C ); the SDK documentation does not state this rate. Camera data (exteroceptive sensor) is explicitly out of scope for this utility and is available through other utilities, including the Unitree specific app. The sensor selection is modular: researchers may record any subset of the above streams for a given session.

blocks.en: III-C Graphical User Interface (GUI)
blocks.zh: III-C 图形用户界面

blocks.en:
The GUI provides a simple interface for managing recording sessions.
Fig. 2 shows the main interface.
blocks.zh:
GUI为管理记录会话提供了一个简单的界面.
图2显示主界面.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: The data collection GUI. Researchers can select sensors, choose or define terrain types, start and stop recordings, add timestamped annotations, and monitor live sensor readouts.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 数据收集图形用户界面。 研究人员可以选择传感器,选择或定义地形类型,开始并停止录音,添加有时间戳的注释,并监视活传感器读取.

blocks.en: The typical workflow is as follows. The researcher selects which sensor streams to record and chooses a terrain label from a dropdown menu. Terrain labels are pre-populated with common types but new labels can be created and added at any time. A session filename is auto-populated but remains editable. The researcher presses Start Logging , walks the robot over the terrain of interest, and may insert timestamped text annotations at any point during the session, for example to mark gait transitions or flag anomalies. These annotations are written directly into the CSV at the corresponding timestamp. A live readout panel displays the current IMU and foot force sensor values, allowing the researcher to confirm that data is being received correctly. When the session is complete, the researcher presses Stop & Save and the CSV is finalized.
blocks.zh: 典型的工作流程如下. 研究者选择哪些传感器流来记录,并从下放菜单中选择地形标签. 地平线标签预先被同类型人所接受,但可以随时创建并添加新的标签. 会话文件名是自动流行的,但仍可编辑 。 研究者按下"开始日志"(Start Digging ),将机器人行走于感兴趣的地平线上,并且可以在会话中的任何时间点上插入有时间戳的文字说明,例如标记行走过渡或旗帜异常. 这些说明会以相应的时间戳直接写入CSV. 一个活读出面板显示当前的IMU和脚力感应值,使研究者能够确认数据正被正确接收. 当会话完成后,研究人员会按下Stop & Save,CSV完成.

blocks.en: III-D Data Output Format
blocks.zh: 三-D 数据输出格式

blocks.en: Each recording session is exported as a CSV file in which each row corresponds to a single timestamped sample containing the selected sensor values. Annotations are embedded as labeled entries at their respective timestamps. This format requires no special parsing library and is directly compatible with standard Python data science libraries such as pandas and NumPy.
blocks.zh: 每个录制会话被导出为 CSV 文件,其中每行对应一个包含所选传感器值的单倍加印样本. 说明被嵌入作为标签条目,分别贴出时间戳. 这种格式不需要特殊解析库,直接兼容Python标准数据科学库如熊猫和NumPy.

Foot position and velocity are described by the SDK only as relative to the body; it does not document their units or axis directions, so the units listed for them are inferred from the observed value ranges. Joint torque is the robot’s estimate, and foot force is a raw sensor reading without documented units.

blocks.en: III-E Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 三-E 执行详情

blocks.en:
The C++ backend runs three concurrent LoopFunc threads provided
by the Unitree SDK: a control loop, a UDP (User Datagram Protocol) send loop, and a UDP receive
loop, all scheduled at d ​ t = 0.002 ​ s dt=0.002\,s (500 Hz). The control loop polls
the latest robot state via udp.GetRecv , but the robot sends
high-level state packets at roughly
50 Hz in our measurements (Section IV-C ), so about nine of every ten polls
return a state that has already been seen. To
avoid logging repeated states, a CSV row is written only when the SDK’s
received-packet counter has advanced since the previous poll, so each row
corresponds to one newly received packet and the effective logging rate
equals the packet arrival rate. In addition to the 73 sensor channels, each
row stores the host timestamp of the poll that detected the packet, the
SDK’s cumulative received-packet counter, and its cumulative CRC and
packet-loss error counters. Gaps in the packet counter and increases in the
error counters therefore identify dropped or corrupted packets in
post-processing, and the achieved sampling rate and timestamp jitter can be
computed directly from the logs. Timestamps record when a packet was
detected on the host, not when the robot generated it, so they include
network and scheduling latency.

The Python GUI spawns the compiled backend as a subprocess and
communicates with it over standard I/O. Recording commands start , stop , pause , resume , terrain , marker , and toggle are written to the backend’s stdin.

flushed to disk every 500 samples (about 10 ​ s 10\,s at 50 Hz) to protect
against data loss on unexpected termination.

blocks.en: IV Terrain Classification Demonstration
blocks.zh: 四. 地表分类示范

blocks.en: This section is a demonstration, not the main contribution. To show that data collected with this utility can support a downstream machine learning task, we collected a multi-terrain dataset on a physical Unitree Go1 and trained a terrain classifier. The classifier is a simple baseline, and its modest accuracy should be read as a statement about this small dataset, not about the utility. The evidence that matters for the utility is the acquisition quality analysis below.
blocks.zh: 本节为示范,不是主要贡献. 为了表明使用这一工具所收集的数据可以支持下游机器学习任务,我们收集了物理Unitree Go1上的多地形数据集,并培训了地形分类器。 分类器是一个简单的基线,其微小的准确度应被解读为关于这个小数据集的声明,而不是关于效用的声明. 与此有关的证据是下文的购置质量分析。

blocks.en: IV-A Data Collection Protocol
blocks.zh: IV-A 数据收集议定书

blocks.en: Data was collected across ten terrain types: carpet, tiles, concrete, asphalt, snow, deep snow, bricks, ice, stair, and high-friction surface. For each terrain, recordings were made using all three available Go1 gaits: walking, running, and the high-clearance climbing gait. Recordings were made on three days (February 10 and 11, and March 30, 2026), and each terrain was recorded on one to three of these days. All data was collected on the physical robot using the presented utility.
blocks.zh: 收集的数据有10个地形类型:地毯、瓦片、混凝土、沥青、雪、深雪、砖块、冰、楼梯和高平地表。 每个地形都使用所有三个可用的Go1行走道进行录音:行走道、跑道和高空攀登道。 收录时间为3日(2026年2月10日和11日,同年3月30日),并记录了这些天中的1至3个地形. 所有关于物理机器人的数据都是利用所展示的效用收集的。

blocks.en: IV-B Dataset Summary
blocks.zh: 四-B 数据集摘要

blocks.en: Table II summarizes the 51 recordings, which total 58.0 minutes of wall-clock time, between 0.4 and 13.9 minutes per terrain. These logs were written by the original logger version, which appended a row on every 2 ms poll of the control loop (1,613,379 rows in total). Most rows repeat the previous robot state, as analyzed in Section IV-C ; only 156,932 rows (9.7%) are distinct robot states. Class sizes reflect the availability of each terrain type during collection, with concrete and deep snow being the most extensively sampled.
blocks.zh: 表二汇总了51个录音记录,每道地形总共为58.0分钟的墙上时间,在0.4至13.9分钟之间. 这些日志由原始的日志版本所写出,该版本在控制回路的每2ms的民意测验上附加一行(共计1,613,379行). 如第四节-C所分析,大多数行重复了以前的机器人状态;只有156,932行(9.7%)是独特的机器人状态. 等级大小反映了收集过程中每种地形类型的可用性,以混凝土和深雪为取样范围最广.

blocks.en:
TABLE II: Dataset summary. Duration is wall-clock recording time. Distinct
states are rows whose sensor channels differ from the previous row.
blocks.zh:
表格 二:数据集汇总. 持续时间是时钟录制时间。 区分
状态是其传感器通道与上行不同的行.

blocks.en: IV-C Acquisition Quality of the Collected Logs
blocks.zh: 收集的日志的质量

blocks.en: The original log format has no packet counter, so freshness was assessed by comparing each row with the previous one: a row whose 73 sensor channels are all identical to the previous row is a repeated state. By this measure 90.3% of rows are repeats, and the distinct robot states arrive at a median of 49.9 Hz per recording. The earlier public release of the logger documented a rate of about 60 Hz; the SDK documentation states no rate, and the measured rate is the one we rely on. The interval between consecutive distinct states has a median of 20.0 ms, and 98.8% of intervals fall between 15 and 25 ms. A further 0.9% fall between 35 and 50 ms, which is consistent with one missed packet, and 0.2% are 50 ms or longer, including two stalls of 10.5 s and 49.4 s in two recordings. Ten of the 51 recordings have a distinct-state rate below 48 Hz (between 9.0 and 47.7 Hz); the lowest, concrete trial 7, delivers new states at only 9.0 Hz. We did not exclude any recording from the analysis below.
blocks.zh: 原始的日志格式没有包计数器,因此通过将每行与上行相提并论来评估新鲜度:一行其73个传感器通道都与上行完全相同的是重复状态. 通过这一措施,90.3%的行是重复的,不同的机器人状态达到中位数为49.9。 每张录音都是Hz 更早的公开发布日志记录了大约60赫兹的速率;SDK文档表示没有速率,所测速率是我们所依赖的. 相接不同的状态之间的间隔为中位数20.0ms,而间隔的98.8%的间隔为15至25ms. 另有0.9%的跌幅为35至50毫秒,这与一包漏出的数据一致,0.2%为50毫秒或更长时间,包括两段10.5秒和49.4秒的两段录音. 在51个录音中,有10个的明显状态速率低于48赫兹(介于9.0至47.7赫兹之间);最低的,混凝土的试验7,只提供9.0赫兹的新状态. 我们不排除下文分析中的任何记录。

blocks.en: This analysis has limits. A genuine new packet that is bit-identical to the previous one would be counted as a repeat, although with floating-point IMU and joint channels this is unlikely. The legacy format also cannot distinguish packet loss on the network from stalls on the robot or the logging computer, because the SDK’s receive and error counters were not recorded. Timestamps are host-side with 2 ms polling resolution. The current logger release records the packet counter and the CRC and loss counters in every row so that these quantities can be measured directly.
blocks.zh: 这种分析是有限度的。 一个与上一个完全相同的真正新数据包将算作重复,尽管有浮动点的IMU和联合频道,这是不可能的。 遗留格式也无法区分网络上的包丢失与机器人或记录计算机上的摊位,因为SDK的收发和出错计数器没有被记录. 时间戳是主机一侧,有2 ms的投票分辨率. 目前的日志发布器记录包计数器和CRC以及每行的损失计数器,以便直接测量这些数量.

blocks.en: IV-D Model and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: IV-D 模式和评价议定书

blocks.en: We trained a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) [ 13 ] , an LSTM, and a standard 1D-CNN. The TCN is intentionally shallow so that inference is cheap enough for real-time use. Before training, repeated rows were removed so that each sample is one distinct robot state, and a window of 100 samples therefore spans about 2 s. Channels were normalized with the mean and standard deviation of the training windows only; no hand-crafted feature engineering was applied. Training used Adam (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch size 64) for 15 epochs. The final epoch is evaluated, with no checkpoint selection and no hyperparameter tuning on test data. Class imbalance was handled with class-balanced sampling and with on-the-fly augmentation (Gaussian jitter, amplitude scaling, and time warping) applied to training data only. Windows were extracted with a stride of 10 samples for training and 50 samples for testing.
blocks.zh: 我们训练了一个临时革命网络 [13],一个LSTM,和一个标准的1D-CNN. TCN是有意地浅取出,这样推论就足够便宜,可以实时使用. 在训练之前,重复的行被取出,这样每个样本就是一个独特的机器人状态,因此100个样本的窗口跨度约为2 s. 频道只与培训窗口的平均和标准的偏差正常化;没有采用手工制作的地物工程。 培训用Adam(学习率10 - 3 10 - 3),批量尺寸64),用于15个时代。 对最终的时代进行评价,不选择检查站,也不对测试数据进行超参数调整。 班级不平衡是用班级平衡取样和飞行上增强(Gausian jitter、振幅缩放和时间扭曲)处理的,只适用于培训数据。 取出Windows时采用了10个供培训用的样品和50个供测试用的样品。

blocks.en: We evaluate under two protocols. In the recording-level protocol, whole recordings are held out: for each terrain with two or more recordings, about 20% of the recordings (at least one) are randomly assigned to the test set, so no test window shares a recording with any training window. Asphalt and bricks have a single recording each, so the first 75% of each recording is used for training and the last 20% or fewer for testing, with the samples between them (at least 100, one window length) discarded. In the window-level protocol, windows from all recordings are randomly assigned 80/20 to training and test sets. Neighboring windows overlap and come from the same recording, so this protocol lets near-duplicate windows appear on both sides of the split. We repeat each protocol over several random splits (five for the TCN recording-level result, three for the TCN window-level result and for the other recording-level results, and one otherwise) and report mean and standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 我们根据两项协议进行评估。 在录制级别协议中,整个录音被保存出:对于每个地形有2个或更多的录音,大约20%的录音(至少一个)被随机分配到测试集,因此没有测试窗口与任何培训窗口共享录音. Asphart和砖头各有一回记录,因此每回记录的前75%用于训练,最后20%或更少用于测试,它们之间的样本(至少100个,一个窗口长度)被丢弃. 在窗口级别的协议中,来自所有录音的窗口被随机指定为80/20用于培训和测试集. 相邻的窗口相重叠并来自同一种录音,因此这个协议让近相重复的窗口出现在分块的两侧. 我们在几个随机分拆的基础上重复每个协议(五个是TCN录制级结果,三个是TCN录制窗口级结果,另一个是录制级结果,另一个是),并报告平均值和标准偏差。

blocks.en: IV-E Results
blocks.zh: 四-E 结果

blocks.en: Table III reports accuracy under both protocols. Under the recording-level protocol the TCN reaches 37.7 ± 7.1 % 37.7\pm 7.1\% over five splits. This is well above the 10% expected by chance for ten balanced classes and above the 23% obtained by always predicting the most common test class (concrete), but far below the window-level result of 98.6 ± 0.3 % 98.6\pm 0.3\% for the same model on the same data. The 1D-CNN and LSTM show the same gap, and the differences among the three architectures are within the variation across splits, so we do not claim one is better.
blocks.zh: 表 三 报告两个议定书下的准确性。 根据记录层协议,TCN在分出5个部分后达到37.7±7.1% 37.7\pm 7.1+%. 这远远高于10个平衡类的10%,高于常预测最常见的测试类(混凝土)获得的23%,但远远低于同一数据上同一模型的98.6±0.3%的窗口结果。 1D-CNN和LSTM显示出同样的差距,三个建筑之间的差别都存在于分化的变异中,所以我们并不声称一个是更好的.

blocks.en:
TABLE III: Test accuracy (%, mean ± \pm standard deviation over random
splits; n n is the number of splits) for ten terrain classes.
blocks.zh:
表三: 国家 测试精度(%), 平均值±\pm 标准差大于随机
分数;nn是分数),用于10个地形类.

blocks.en: Table IV and Fig. 3 give per-class results for the TCN under the recording-level protocol, pooled over the five splits. Deep snow and ice are recognized best, and asphalt, high friction, and stair worst. Bricks has only 10 test windows, and asphalt and bricks are evaluated on a held-out segment of one recording rather than on a held-out recording, so their entries are weak evidence.
blocks.zh: 表四和图三列出记录级协议下的TCN的每类结果,在5个拆分中汇总。 深雪和冰被公认为最好,沥青、高摩擦和楼梯最差。 砖块只有10个测试窗口,沥青和砖块被评价在一个录制中被搁置的部分,而不是被搁置的录制中,因此他们的录制是微弱的证据.

blocks.en:
TABLE IV: Per-class recording-level test accuracy of the TCN, pooled over
five random splits (windows from the same held-out recording can recur
across splits).
blocks.zh:
表格 四:TCN的每级记录水平测试精度,集合于
5个随机分拆(同一搁置记录的窗口可重现)
以平分计。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Confusion matrix of the TCN under the recording-level protocol, summed over five random splits. Each row is normalized to the percentage of that true class.
blocks.zh: 图3:记录级协议下TCN的混淆矩阵,汇总了5个以上的随机分出. 每行都符合该类学生的比例。

blocks.en: We did not isolate why held-out recordings are so much harder. Windows from one recording share session-specific conditions such as gait, speed, and battery state, which a model can exploit when they appear on both sides of a split. Terrain is also partly confounded with collection day and gait, because each terrain was recorded on only one to three days. These results show that the logged signals contain terrain information. They do not show that this dataset supports reliable terrain classification on unseen recordings, and we do not present the classifier as competitive.
blocks.zh: 我们没有孤立为什么被搁置的录音这么难。 Windows来自一个录制共享会话特定条件,如行走方式,速度,和电池状态等,当一个模型出现在分块的两侧时,它可以被利用. Terrain也部分地对收集日及步态感到困惑,因为每个地形只记录了一到三天. 这些结果显示已登录的信号包含地形信息. 它们并不显示这个数据集支持在不见踪影的录音上进行可靠的地貌分类,我们也不将分类器呈现为具有竞争力.

blocks.en: IV-F Dataset and Code Availability
blocks.zh: IV-F 数据集和代码可用性

blocks.en:
The 51 recordings analyzed here are not currently distributed with the repositories. The classifier repository contains the evaluation code ( evaluate.py ) that produces the results above, which removes repeated rows from legacy logs before windowing; the logger repository contains a script that reports acquisition quality for any log and a tool that removes repeated rows from legacy logs. Each log file follows the naming convention log_{terrain}_trial{n}_{date}.csv and is directly
compatible with standard Python data science libraries such as pandas
and NumPy.
blocks.zh:
此处分析的51个录音目前没有与储存库一起分发。 分类器寄存器包含产生上述结果的评价代码(valu.py),在窗口设置前从遗留日志中删除了重复行;日志寄存器包含一个脚本,报告任何日志的获取质量,以及一个从遗留日志中删除重复行的工具. 每个日志文件都遵循命名会议日志(log-_{terrain}_trii{n}_{datedate}.csv),并且是直接的.
符合标准 Python 数据科学库如熊猫
还有NumPy。

blocks.en: IV-G Real-Time Deployment
blocks.zh: IV-G 实时部署

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the full pipeline from data collection to on-robot
inference, the companion training utility supports real-time terrain
classification on the physical Go1. The live deployment mode reuses the
same C++ backend as the data logger: the GUI loads a saved checkpoint
comprising model weights, a fitted StandardScaler , a terrain
label map, and architecture metadata, then spawns the backend and reads
its continuous DATA stream. A sliding window buffer accumulates
incoming samples, and once the buffer is full, inference runs every ten new
samples. Because DATA lines are emitted once per newly received state, a live window of 100 samples covers the same roughly 2 s that training windows do. We have not evaluated live prediction accuracy on the robot. The predicted terrain class, its softmax confidence score, and
per-class probability bars are displayed in real time. This closes the
loop between collection and deployment without requiring any additional
software beyond the companion repository [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
展示从数据收集到机器人的整个管道
推断, 同伴训练工具支持实时地形
物理Go1的分类。 即时部署模式重新使用
与数据记录器相同的 C++ 后端: GUI 加载已保存的检查点
包括模型加权、装有标准比例尺、地形
标签映射和架构元数据,然后生成后端并读取
其连续DATA流. 滑动窗口缓冲器累积
进入的样本,一旦缓冲器满了, 推论每10个新的
样本。 由于DATA线在新接收的状态下一旦被排放,100个样本的活出窗口覆盖大约相当于训练窗口的2分之2。 我们没有评估机器人的现场预测准确性。 预测的地貌等级, 其软最大信心分数,
每等概率栏以实时显示。 这关闭了
收集与部署之间的循环,不需要额外
软件超越了同伴寄存器[14].

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: We measured a state rate of roughly 50 Hz in the high-level SDK mode; the SDK documentation does not state this rate, and we did not test other robot configurations. Future work may explore low-level SDK access to increase the acquisition rate.
blocks.zh: 我们在高级SDK模式中测出大约50Hz的状态速率;SDK文档没有说明这个速率,也没有测试其他机器人配置. 今后的工作可能探索低水平的SDK接入,以提升获取率.

blocks.en: Limitations. The validation in this paper is a demonstration, not a full characterization of the data. First, the recording-level test sets are small (about ten held-out recordings per split), the held-out recordings are chosen at random, terrain is confounded with collection day and gait, and two terrains are evaluated on a time segment of a single recording; the resulting accuracy varies widely across splits. Second, the recordings predate the packet and error counters, so packet loss could not be measured, and we kept every recording, including one whose robot state updates at only 9 Hz. Third, we do not compare the workflow quantitatively against ROS1 logging, raw SDK scripts, or other data collection practices, so the claim that the utility lowers the barrier to Go1 research rests on its design rather than on a measured comparison. Finally, timestamps are host-side and do not account for latency between the robot and the logging computer.
blocks.zh: 限制。 本文中的验证是论证,而不是对数据的完全定性. 首先,录制水平测试集规模小(每分录制约10个被搁置的录音),随机选择被搁置的录音,地形与收录日相混淆并步相通,两个地形对单个录制的时间段进行评价;由此产生的精度因分录而大相径庭. 第二,录音早于数据包和错误计数器,所以数据包损失无法测量,我们保留了每段录音,包括一个机器人状态更新只有9Hz. 第三,我们不把工作流程与ROS1记录、原始SDK脚本或其他数据收集做法进行定量比较,因此,关于实用性降低Go1研究障碍的说法取决于其设计,而不是经过衡量的比较。 最后,时间戳是主机侧面,不考虑机器人和伐木计算机之间的耐久性.

blocks.en: The utility is intentionally scoped to proprioceptive sensing. Camera and depth sensor integration is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 其用途有意被限定为自行感知. 相机和深度传感器集成留给未来工作。

blocks.en:
Although the current implementation targets the Go1, the architecture
is readily adaptable to newer Unitree platforms. The Go2 and G1 each
ship with distinct SDKs from the one used here; migrating to either
platform requires retargeting the C++ backend against the respective
SDK, while the Python GUI layer requires no platform-specific
modification. The high-level access patterns across these
platforms are analogous, so the adaptation effort is expected to be
minor. Labs working with the Go2 or G1 should therefore be able to
extend this utility with minimal effort.
blocks.zh:
虽然目前的实施目标是GO1,但结构
很容易适应新的Unitree平台。 GO2和G1各一个
与这里使用的SDK不同的船舶; 迁移到其中之一
C++ 后端对应
SDK, 而 Python GUI 层则不需要特定平台
修改。 高级别接触模式
平台是类似的,因此预计适应工作将
轻微。 因此,与GO2或G1合作的实验室应当能够
尽量不增加使用。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: We have presented an open-source, GUI-based proprioceptive data collection utility for the Unitree Go1. The tool interfaces directly with the Unitree SDK via a C++ backend, eliminating any dependency on ROS, and exposes a Python GUI that allows any researcher to record joint states, IMU data, gyroscope data, and foot force sensor data with minimal setup. Data is exported as structured CSV files ready for use in machine learning pipelines. We characterized the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with the utility, finding a distinct-state rate of about 50 Hz and that most rows in the original log format were repeats, which the current release avoids by logging only newly received packets. A TCN terrain classifier reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes, against about 99% under a window-level split, so the logged signals carry terrain information, but cross-recording generalization on this small dataset is limited. The classifier is a demonstration of the data’s value, not the contribution of this work. The utility is available at https://github.com/RoLACLab/go1-proprioceptive-logger under the MIT License, and the evaluation code is available at https://github.com/RoLACLab/go1-proprioceptive-classifier .
blocks.zh: 我们为Unitree Go1提供了基于GUI的自控数据收集工具。 该工具通过C++后端直接与Unitree SDK相接,消除了对ROS的任何依赖,并暴露出一个Python GUI,它允许任何研究人员记录联合状态,IMU数据,陀螺仪数据,以及最小设置的脚力传感器数据. 数据作为结构化的CSV文件导出,准备用于机器学习管道. 我们定性了用该工具收集的51个录音的获取质量,发现不同的状态率大约为50赫兹,而原始日志格式中的大多数行都是重复的,而目前的发行只通过记录新收到的数据包来避免。 一个TCN地形分级器在10个地形等级的被搁置录音上达到约38%的准确度,而窗口平分下则达到约99%,因此被记录的信号携带了地形信息,但是这个小数据集上的交叉记录通论是有限的. 分类器是数据价值的证明,而不是这项工作的贡献。 该工具可在https://github.com/RoLACLab/go1-prorioceptive-logger上查阅。 根据麻省理工学院许可证,评价代码见https://github.com/RoLACLab/go1-prorioceptive-classifer。 。 。 。 。
